messages:
alex: starting staged rollout for release v2.4.0 to 10% traffic (region: eu-west) in ~3m. change window 23:00-01:00 UTC. baseline p95=95ms, error rate=0.12%. tagging @maya for observability checks.

deploy-bot: Release v2.4.0 initiated (canary group=eu-west-0, traffic=10%). event_id=rb-1919876543

maya: watching dashboards — will post p95/p99 and 5xx snapshots every 2m. temp alert thresholds set: p95>200ms for 5m OR 5xx>0.8% for 3m -> paging.

jordan: rollout config: kernel-optimizations=on, kvcache_ttl=12s. pinned model hash: sha256:8f3a2b... Rollback path staged and tested locally.

sam: FYI prewarmed pods=6 in eu-west. If node CPU >75% for 3m we fail-safe to fallback model variant.

obs-bot: snapshot @23:03 UTC — p95=102ms p99=210ms 5xx=0.14% heatmap: https://grafana.redwood/s/abcd1234/canary-eu-west

maya: p99 spike looks correlated with tokenization latency in inference-v2. increasing trace sampling for /generate to 50% to capture traces.

alex: agreed. escalation policy: if p95 sustained >180ms for 10m OR p99 >500ms at any time -> rollback. manual rollback also if 5xx >1% sustained.

deploy-bot: scheduled traffic ramp: 30% at +10m (from canary 10%).

jordan: noticing transient 429 bursts on embed-service around 23:05, likely rate-limit backoff causing queueing. log snippet: ```embed-queue-time=450ms service=embed-service instance=eu-west-2```

maya: current alert firing: "canary-latency-eu-west" (p95=220ms over 6m). tagging @sam @alex for oncall. :rotating_light:

sam: investigating nodes — one GPU host (gw-12) has memory spike and OOM kube events. starting drain/rebalance now. if drain doesn't reduce pressure in 2m -> recommend rollback.

alex: hold the traffic ramp. are we breaching rollback criteria? p95>200ms for >5m -> yes. decision: rollback to v2.3.9. will notify customers. @deploy-bot execute rollback.

deploy-bot: rollback command received from alex. Initiating rollback to v2.3.9 on eu-west-0. rollback_ts=1919876601. Steps: 1) shift traffic to v2.3.9 2) scale down v2.4.0 pods 3) confirm healthchecks.

obs-bot: post-rollback snapshot @23:12 UTC — p95=110ms p99=230ms 5xx=0.18%. Metrics trending back to baseline. Marking canary incident state: resolved. :white_check_mark:

maya: will open a short postmortem and attach trace dump. immediate mitigation: revert kernel-optimizations flag for v2.4.0 and increase kvcache_ttl to 20s in next attempt.

jordan: filing release-note entry: "rollback: v2.4.0 -> v2.3.9 due to p95 regression under kernel-opt path; root cause suspected GPU memory pressure + tokenization latency." PR: https://git.redwood/release-notes/pull/482

sam: action items added to oncall board: increase prewarm to 8 for future canaries, add node memory alert at 70%, and add a canary-specific rate-limit smoothing policy.

alex: thanks all. closing thread and logging incident for follow-up.
